basics.name: Richie Ryulie Suganda
basics.label: Robotics Researcher
basics.summary: Robotics researcher at NAIL Lab, University of Houston. My work focuses on building safe and intelligent autonomous systems, with interests spanning robotics, multi-agent coordination, perception, and embedded AI.

work.name: NAIL Lab, University of Houston
work.summary: Conducting research on safe and intelligent autonomous systems, including distributed leader-follower formation control, perception-aware planning with control barrier functions, and human-interactive autonomous system simulation.
